summary: Small and mid-size contractors and developers doing ₹10–500 crore of work a year, plus the lenders who fund them. They run on WhatsApp, Excel and paper, and face growing compliance load from RERA, GST e-invoicing and digital government procurement.
buyer: Owner or finance head at contractor/developer firms; technical head at housing finance companies
user: Site engineers, QS/billing engineers, compliance executives
geography: India; pilots in Maharashtra, Karnataka and Uttar Pradesh
stage: Early adopters already pay for basic site apps; AI layer largely absent

segments.name: Government-works contractors
segments.size_hint: Illustrative: tens of thousands registered on CPPP/GeM
segments.description: Bid on public tenders; heavy measurement-book and running-bill paperwork.

segments.name: Mid-size residential developers
segments.description: Quarterly RERA progress filings, buyer updates, lender milestones.

segments.name: Housing finance lenders
segments.description: Release construction-linked tranches after site inspections.
